about: Calls of conformance/sdk/cases.json whose expectation the Rust types change, merged over it by conformance/sdk-rust: an object schema with no properties is a struct of a BTreeMap in Rust, whose members iterate in key order, where a JavaScript object keeps the order written. The string is the same members, in that order; nothing else differs.
